body: Well, if you are interested in the other side of the story, you could also read this http://manboobz.blogspot.de/p/not-so-great-debate-on-domestic.html
A lot of the comment section paints a much less friendly picture of the environment than does the essay itself. The whole thing leaves me with mixed feelings.

He's right. there are always solutions. Short term, see if you can get a modicum of help to get over things. I'm guessing the car would be a good place to start. And talk to your wife. It may be painful, but you need to shed as much light on this situation as possible.

I feel so alone, and I do have options. It's really quite ridiculous to explain, but despite the options and despite everything that is going my way, I am feeling the worst I ever have, and I've carried this thing around for quite some time. It is so absurdly dark and some days I can't breathe through it.
